Meta.Description: Immutable Source of Truth for Backend API and Database Schema
Meta.Usage: Paste this into the AI Context before generating any API or Data Fetching code.

Protocol.Rule: Single Entry Point (one POST endpoint). RESTful routes (GET /transactions) DO NOT exist.

Authorization: Bearer {JWT}. Each request carries a Supabase session JWT in the Authorization header. The legacy body "key" field is REMOVED. Unauthenticated/invalid-token requests return { status: 'error' }.

family_id is SERVER-DERIVED from the authenticated session and applied server-side. A client-supplied family_id/user_id in the body is ignored/overwritten. Row-Level Security enforces per-family isolation as the backstop.

Row-Level Encryption (v1.14). Sensitive fields ride the per-row `enc` column: an opaque client-encrypted envelope "v1.{b64 iv}.{b64 ciphertext}" (AES-256-GCM, family key, AAD-bound to table:id). The server stores and returns `enc` verbatim, never inspects it, and REJECTS the removed plaintext keys as unknown. Keys never leave family devices; there is no server-side recovery.
Client must use a Request Queue. Network calls are strictly serial.

Strict. Error envelope: { status: 'error', code, message } where `code` is a closed enum - AUTH (401), VALIDATION (400/405, incl. unknown payload keys and malformed bodies), RLS_DENIED (403), CONFLICT (409), INTERNAL (500). Messages are fixed, leak-free texts: VALIDATION carries the authored validation detail; no raw database detail (table, policy, or constraint names) ever reaches the wire.

Action.name: read
Action.Description: Delta Sync. Returns rows modified since timestamp.

Action.name: batchCreate
Action.Description: Bulk Insert. ID is optional (generated by server if missing).

Action.name: batchUpdate
Action.Description: Bulk Edit. Updates ONLY the specific keys provided.

Action.name: batchUpsert
Action.Description: Idempotent Save. Creates if ID missing, Updates if ID exists. Best for Seeding Test Data and sync creates.

Action.name: wipe
Action.Description: Destructive (Test Mode Only). Clears all data in the specified table for the caller's family.

Action.name: version
Action.Description: Lightweight sync probe. Family-scoped; takes no table and no rows. Returns the family high-water mark = max(updated_at) across all tenant tables (or null when the family has no rows), so the client can check on app open whether anything changed since its last sync WITHOUT pulling every collection.

DatabaseSchema.Note: These are LOGICAL KEYS (snake_case). Do not use physical Table Headers.

Field.name: enc
Field.description: Opaque encrypted envelope. Plaintext JSON inside (client-only): { line_id: String (groups the instances of one recurring Budget; random, copied on duplication), live: Boolean (this line duplicates into the next period), period_start: String (ISO YYYY-MM-DD), period_end: String (ISO YYYY-MM-DD), target: Number (optional - what the family intends to spend or save this period; absent = the user skipped it, and the card then shows allocated vs actual only), wallet_ids: String[] (the accounts the Budget aggregates; the first one selected fixed the currency, which is NEVER stored), areas: [{ id: String, name: String, amount: Number, category_ids: String[], icon: String (a lucide icon name; the Area's identity on every card. It is rendered in ONE colour - the Area's HEALTH - so no colour is chosen and none is stored. Optional on the wire and defaulted on read, so a row written without it still opens) }] (the plan; the Area amounts sum to the ALLOCATED total, which is derived and never stored), adjustments: [{ area_id: String, amount: Number }] (period-local reallocations; they die with their period and are never duplicated forward), note: String (optional) }.

Column.description: 'instance' - the only kind. Retained as a plaintext debuggability token and a forward hook; templates no longer exist.
'weekly', 'monthly', 'annual', 'one_off'. Plaintext for debuggability only; the server never computes over it.
Primary Key, formatted as 'e001', or special cases for 'immutable' logic
Opaque encrypted envelope. Plaintext JSON inside (client-only): { name: String, aliases: String[], match_patterns: String[] (regex strings) }.
Primary Key, formatted as 'm001', or special cases for 'immutable' logic
Auth-user link. SERVER-DERIVED, read-only: present in reads, ignored/stripped on writes. The client derives 'Me' as the member whose user_id equals the session uid.

Google sign-in photo. SERVER-MANAGED, read-only: written by the sign-in trigger (handle_new_user), present in reads, ignored/stripped on writes. Render precedence is custom avatar -> google_avatar -> generated initials, so it is a default that never overwrites a custom avatar.
Groups all rows from one import run; enables bulk clear/delete of a batch.
ISO YYYY-MM-DD when resolved; may be empty/unparsed while staged.

Opaque encrypted envelope. Plaintext JSON inside (client-only): { amount: String (RAW import text; parsed to Number on promotion), description: String, tags: String[], source_wallet: String, source_category: String, source_name: String, source_row: Object (the full original import row keyed by source header) }.
ISO code; nullable until derived from the mapped wallet.
'income' | 'expense'; nullable until the category is mapped.
